book.Title: {{W|The Fisher's Patience}}
book.page:
[[Reading the Water]]
A cast is a Sifrah -- a contest of patience and appetite against something that does not wish to be found.
Five steps stand between you and the catch:
reading the water settling the line stilling your breath feeling the bite landing the catch
One answer satisfies each step today. Nothing tells you which. You learn it the way fishers do: by trying, and by watching what the water learns about you in return.

[[Working the Line]]
1 .. 5 pick a step to address left/right walk between steps Z complete the turn Esc walk away
Choosing a step opens the tools you could bring to it. Only what you actually carry or know is offered; the rest is greyed out, and a tool that fails is learned by the water and cannot be used again on that cast.
The chance of landing something is on the right of the screen at all times. Watch it as you choose.

[[Turning the Page]]
A book with more than one page turns with the numpad: 4 or 7 for the page before, 6 or 9 for the page after. The arrow keys do nothing here. Escape closes it.

[[What Will Take Your Hook]]
Not all of it is water.
A line sinks into brine, blood, oil, wine, wax, sludge, ooze, sap, honey -- anything soft enough to pass through.
It will not enter acid, lava or neutron flux. Those eat an ordinary line on contact. You would need a pole built to stand them, and no such pole has been carved yet.
